notes: The crashed Halcyon is now the same size beside the commander as in the opening film, in every story level.
Level 2: KILN's camera on the deck pops up in a small window while the crew keep talking.
Level 4: the flight recorder is wedged in the hull where you can see it, tumbles out onto open sand as you come near, and KILN waits until you're beside it. You also learn why Vale's group left.

Level 5: raiders come in from beyond the screen, the guard's training pad is out in the open, and the helmet lies in plain view on the raider's escape path. The helmet's film plays when you pick it up.
Level 3: Sela explains where the other settlements came from.
